evidence: Read fix.diff in full: the leftover-archive loop in save.go and the new test in save_split_test.go.
Read save.go 60-290 (Save, splitInput, partKey, partOneTitle, savedPartCount, write) and import.go 185-245 (claimTopicKey, liveTopicHolder, freeTopicKey, importRow).
The importer moved key is always <key>~N with N an integer; the predicate matches key||~ plus an all-digit non-empty suffix.
length() and substr() both count characters on TEXT, so non-ASCII keys compare consistently.
The LIKE pattern is built only from integers; keys are bound as plain parameters, so LIKE/GLOB metacharacters in keys or titles cannot inject.
The substr/glob predicate cannot use the topic_key index; bounded by oldParts, not user-visible.
Not evaluated: parts i <= len(pieces) whose key another memory holds go through write, which this commit does not touch.
